title: test_advance_gate_scripted_request_still_gated is vacuous — it cannot fail if a scripted advance ignores the gate
evidence:
_, evs := gate_record_run(&s, 700, cat)
	defer delete(evs)
	testing.expect_value(t, s.era, u8(3))
	testing.expect(t, !s.replay_error, "a gated scripted advance must not latch replay_error")
detail: Final era==3 cannot distinguish an ungated scripted fire at tick 100 from the gated fire at 600 — era 3's standard pipes are legacy (test table unlocks wide), blocking 3→4 both ways. The spine behavior 'scripted advance gated identically' is unpinned; no golden covers scripted+gate (era_advance.dem is gate-off).
recommended_fix: Assert the Era_Advanced event's tick >= milestone_window_ticks (600), or step only 500 ticks (<600) and expect era==2 with the latch held. Optionally add a scripted-advance + `advance gate on` golden.

title: The W6 demand_era binding has no distinguishing test — the only divergent row (era 4 → demand_era 3) is never observed
detail: The only direct scripted_plan_demand call (era_test.odin:119) uses era 3 (aligned); both tests reaching era 4 assert only the era byte/events, never demand content. Reverting to demand.eras[era-1] passes the suite and goldens — the real catalog is 1:1 aligned.
recommended_fix: Post-advance in the E14 test (or a unit row), call scripted_plan_demand(cat, 4, tick) and assert non-empty entries with the streaming class — the direct index returns an empty plan in era 4.

title: Tag-14 event payload byte-layout unpinned (the B2-3 byte-layout convention covers tags 1..7 and 4.2, not the new tag)
detail: The byte-layout pins (warnings_test.test_event_payload_byte_layout, crisis_test.test_crisis_event_payload_byte_layout) predate tag 14. Live and replay share the write path, so a wrong-field byte (e.g. e.class) is invisible to every test.
recommended_fix: Add a tag-14 row to the byte-layout pin: one w_event_payload call with reason=.Sla plus an exact length/byte assert (1 byte).

title: Advance-block validation boundary values (window 20000, bar 1, bar 100) have no load-clean rows
evidence:
{"milestone too big", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"milestone_window_ticks": 600`, `"milestone_window_ticks": 20001`, 1), "must be 1..20000 with all keys present"},
		{"sla pct zero", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"sla_uptime_pct": 95`, `"sla_uptime_pct": 0`, 1), "must be 1..100 (the per-class delivery bar"},
		{"sla pct 101", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"sla_uptime_pct": 95`, `"sla_uptime_pct": 101`, 1), "must be 1..100 (the per-class delivery bar"},
detail: Negative rows cover 0/101/20001 and the positive row loads 14400, but the exact bounds have no load-clean rows — an off-by-one cap (`>= 20000` or `> 100` rejecting) would pass unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add positive load-clean rows at the bounds: milestone_window_ticks 20000, sla_uptime_pct 1, and sla_uptime_pct 100.

detail: P0 100% (fire, SLA/legacy/crisis blocks, replay identity — unit+golden+drift levels). P1 ≈83%: scripted-under-gate pin vacuous (~50%), block-event count asserts still carried (W1). Overall ≥80%. Sparse-table rejection, cap rows, and ci-local gate-demo replays verified covered.
